card.name: Outcome-deciding words in tipping-point phrases
card.fires_on: Words that finish a phrase about one factor deciding a result, such as 'outcome' after 'affecting the', or 'between' after 'the difference'. Mostly in general web text about elections and about life-or-death contrasts.

modes.label: Election outcome
modes.description: The word 'outcome' after a vote is said to affect or change the result of an election.
modes.example: the chance of a single vote affecting the<< outcome>> of the election would be about one million

modes.label: Difference between
modes.description: 'Difference' or 'between' in phrases like 'the difference between life and death' or 'success and failure'.
modes.example: which can sometimes mean the difference<< between>> life and death.

modes.label: Close margin or tipping
modes.description: Other words that mark a narrow margin or a push over a threshold.
modes.example: escaping by the closest possible<< margin>>

card.writes: It seems to push toward threshold and qualifying words, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on phrases about a small factor tipping a result, like one vote changing an election or the difference between life and death.
